confident.description: Self-assured and trusting in their own abilities.

smart.description: Quick to understand ideas and solve problems; intellectual ability rather than accumulated facts.

funny.description: Often makes people laugh through jokes or humour.
funny.flip: tries too hard, laughs at their own jokes

hardworking.description: Spends sustained effort and time on work, regardless of long-term ambitions.

ambitious.description: Strongly seeks future achievement, advancement or challenging goals.

creative.description: Invents original ideas or expresses imagination through making things.

organized.description: Plans and structures tasks, schedules and information; not merely keeping spaces clean.

athletic.description: Enjoys or excels at physical exercise and sports.
athletic.flip: gym bro who only talks about protein

generous.description: Readily gives money, possessions or time to others.

honest.description: Tells the truth and communicates sincerely.

loyal.description: Remains committed to friends, groups or relationships.

adventurous.description: Seeks new experiences, excitement or risks.

calm.description: Stays emotionally composed under stress or pressure.

caring.description: Shows concern for others feelings and wellbeing.

tidy.description: Keeps physical spaces and belongings clean and orderly.
tidy.flip: neat freak who panics at crumbs

knowledgeable.description: Has accumulated many facts or expertise; knowledge rather than raw problem-solving ability.
knowledgeable.flip: trivia bore who never stops lecturing

musical.description: Plays instruments, sings or engages deeply with making music.
musical.flip: brings a guitar to every party uninvited

bookish.description: Enjoys reading books and literary pursuits.

independent.description: Relies on themselves and prefers acting without others help.
independent.flip: too proud to ever ask for help

optimistic.description: Expects positive outcomes and notices the bright side.

outgoing.description: Enjoys social interaction and readily engages with people.

easygoing.description: Is flexible and undemanding about preferences or plans; not specifically composure under stress.

competitive.description: Strongly wants to win and compares performance with others.
competitive.flip: sore loser who turns everything into a contest

meticulous.description: Pays close attention to detail, precision and correctness.

helpful.description: Actively assists others with their needs or tasks.

spontaneous.description: Acts on impulse without much advance planning.

disciplined.description: Consistently follows routines or exercises self-control.

charming.description: Uses charisma and social warmth to attract or please people.

humble.description: Is modest about their abilities and achievements.
humble.flip: fake modesty, master of the humblebrag

healthy.description: Prioritizes nutritious food, wellness and health-conscious habits.
healthy.flip: kale preacher who judges your lunch

romantic.description: Expresses affection and idealizes love or romantic gestures.

responsible.description: Reliably fulfills duties and takes accountability.
responsible.flip: the no-fun parent of the friend group

curious.description: Wants to learn, explore ideas and ask questions.
curious.flip: nosy, asks way too many questions

entrepreneurial.description: Starts ventures or seeks business opportunities.
entrepreneurial.flip: side-hustle guy pitching crypto at dinner

wise.description: Shows good judgment and insight drawn from experience.

eloquent.description: Expresses ideas fluently and persuasively in words.
eloquent.flip: uses big words to hear their own voice

punctual.description: Consistently arrives or completes commitments on time.
punctual.flip: judges everyone who's a minute late

patient.description: Tolerates waiting, delays or frustration without becoming upset.
patient.flip: so slow they never get anything done

worldly.description: Has broad cultural experience and familiarity with places or ways of life.
worldly.flip: won't stop saying 'when I was in Bali'

frugal.description: Carefully limits spending and avoids waste.
frugal.flip: cheapskate who splits the bill to the cent
